hero.title: The mess khata, without the month‑end argument
hero.subtitle: Log meals, bazaar and deposits as they happen. MessMate works out the meal rate and what each member owes, and everyone in the mess sees the same numbers.
hero.trust: Free for every mess. No card, no trial, in Bangla and English.

problem.title: Most messes run on a notebook, a group chat and someone's memory

notebook.n1: Meals in one notebook, bazaar in another
notebook.n2: Deposits buried in the group chat
notebook.n3: An evening with a calculator every month end

app.a1: Every meal and expense in one place, by date
app.a2: Each deposit recorded against the person who paid it
app.a3: Meal rate and balances updated as you go
app.a4: Anyone can check who added what, and when

features.title: Three things every mess has to keep straight
features.subtitle: Meals, money and trust. Each has its own page in MessMate, and every member can open it.

meals.title: Meals, counted per person per day
meals.body: The manager marks who ate lunch, dinner or sehri. Half meals work, and you choose the meal types your mess actually has.

money.title: Bazaar, bills and deposits in one ledger
money.body: Members add what they bought and a manager approves it. Shared bills like gas and internet are split across the mess, and personal costs stay with one person.

trust.title: Every change is on the record
trust.body: Each meal edit, expense, deposit and role change is logged with who made it and when. Up to two managers run the mess with equal permissions, and members see everything they see.

howItWorks.title: How a month runs
howItWorks.subtitle: Set it up once, record things as they happen, and close the month when it ends.

account.title: Create your mess
account.description: Sign up with email or Google and name your mess. Whoever creates it becomes its manager.

members.title: Add your flatmates
members.description: Invite them by name or email and they accept from their own dashboard. For someone without a smartphone, create the account for them.

month.title: Start the month
month.description: Open a month, say December 2026. Every meal and expense from then on belongs to it.

meals.title: Record the day's meals
meals.description: Pick the date and tap each member's meals. Half meals count too.

money.title: Add bazaar, bills and deposits
money.description: Members submit what they bought for approval. Add shared bills, personal costs and each deposit as money comes in.

closeMonth.title: Close the month
closeMonth.description: MessMate freezes the month, archives the summary and opens the next one.

howItWorks.carry: When a month closes, money you're owed becomes your first deposit next month, and money you owe becomes your own expense to settle.

accounting.title: The maths, written out
accounting.subtitle: There's one formula, and every member can see each number that goes into it.

lines.rate: Meal rate = total bazaar ÷ total meals
lines.cost: Your meal cost = your meals × meal rate
lines.balance: Your balance = your deposits − your meal cost − your share of shared bills − your personal costs

accounting.rollNote: Close the month and these balances carry into September.

what.a: A free app for running a shared mess in Bangladesh. It replaces the notebook and the spreadsheet with one place for meals, bazaar, bills, deposits and the month-end accounts.

free.a: Yes. There's no pricing page, no trial and no card. Create an account and start.

accounting.q: Do I need to know accounting?
accounting.a: No. You record what happened, and MessMate works out the meal rate, each member's meal cost and every balance.

join.a: A manager invites each flatmate by name or email from the Members page, and they accept from their own dashboard. For someone without a smartphone, the manager can create the account.

months.a: A manager opens a month and closes it when it ends. The closed month is archived as it was, the next one opens, and balances carry forward.

manager.a: Whoever creates the mess is its first manager and can promote one more member. A mess can have two managers, with the same permissions.

balances.q: What happens to balances at month end?
balances.a: Money you're owed becomes part of your next deposit. Money you owe becomes an individual expense in the new month.

visible.a: Yes. Meal rate, deposits, expenses, balances and the full activity history are open to everyone in the mess.

finalCta.title: Start this month's khata in MessMate
finalCta.subtitle: Create your mess, add your flatmates and record tonight's dinner. It's free for every mess.
finalCta.installHint: On a phone? Install MessMate like an app

footer.tagline: Simple mess management and transparent accounting. Meal tracking, expenses, deposits, and month-end — all in one calm place for shared living.
